reuse.why: Introduces a shared category query and bulk loop, but reads group notes from a new category_groups.notes column instead of the tree's existing notes table (keyed by group id, used by NotesButton), and setBulkAverage restates setNMonthAvg's average-and-sign logic.

duplication.why: The three copied average actions are consolidated, but the template/hidden exclusions are re-expressed in getBudgetData (has_templates CASE) and copyPreviousMonth's own check, and the expense sign flip is written in setBulkAverage, setLastMonthSpending and setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: Adding a schema migration and an AQL field for group notes puts the #fixed tag outside the notes storage layer the app already uses; the bulk-selection code itself is placed sensibly in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Beyond the four requested behaviours it adds a DB migration, an AQL schema field and a DbCategoryGroup field that the requests did not call for.

maintainability.why: The month-wide rule lives in two paths that already disagree (copyPreviousMonth ignores #fixed and includeHiddenCategories) and the #fixed tag is read from a column nothing writes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts reads g.notes from a new column instead of the notes table; copyPreviousMonth bypasses getBulkBudgetCategories and keeps its own hidden/template check.

disguised_duplication.where: getBudgetData's `CASE WHEN c.goal_def IS NULL ... AS has_templates` plus copyPreviousMonth's hidden/has_templates check restate getBulkBudgetCategories' WHERE clause in a different shape.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with an `(? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))` branch; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it and misses the #fixed and includeHiddenCategories rules.
